samaveda_hymn8.title: The Kena Upanishad
samaveda_hymn8.description: The Kena Upanishad is an important philosophical text associated with the Samaveda. Its name comes from its opening word 'Kena' meaning 'by whom'.

samaveda_hymn8.introduction: The Kena Upanishad is an important philosophical text associated with the Samaveda. Its name comes from its opening word 'Kena' meaning 'by whom'.
samaveda_hymn8.scripture_text: A representative Samavedic hymn passage for Hymn 8, expressing melodic devotion, sacred recitation, and meditative harmony.
samaveda_hymn8.philosophical_explanation: The Kena Upanishad teaches that the ultimate reality cannot be fully grasped by the mind or described by words, yet it is the very power that enables thinking, seeing and knowing. True wisdom lies in recognizing this mysterious foundation of all experience.
